title: Prävention im Fokus: Polizei Berlin lädt zur Sonderberatung am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026 ein

extraction.summaryEn: Police and a carpentry guild invite the public to a free burglary prevention advice day on 25 October 2026 at the police headquarters. Security equipment will be shown and a window break-in test demonstrated.
